name: pl-income-tax
description: Polish personal income tax (PIT) for individuals and the self-employed for tax year 2026. Covers residence, the three tax forms for a sole trader (the 12% and 32% scale with the PLN 30,000 tax-free amount and PLN 120,000 threshold; the 19% flat tax with the PLN 14,100 health deduction limit; ryczałt on revenue at 2% to 17% with the 2026 eligibility limit of EUR 2 million, PLN 8,517,200), the 4% solidarity levy above PLN 1 million, IP Box at 5%, joint filing for spouses and single parents, the main reliefs (child relief, the PLN 85,528 reliefs, losses), the PIT-36, PIT-36L, PIT-28 and PIT-37 returns due 30 April 2027, and monthly or quarterly advances. Trigger on: PIT 2026, skala podatkowa, podatek liniowy, ryczałt, danina solidarnościowa, wspólne rozliczenie, zaliczki PIT, PIT-36. Out of scope: ZUS in pl-zus-contributions; employee withholding in pl-payroll; mandate contracts in pl-civil-law-contracts; non-residents and foreign income in pl-cross-border; shares, crypto and property gai
